race.comment: Tricky race. PUFFIN (9) keeps raising the bar this prep with the three dominant wins in fast time. Showed blistering speed from the wide draw with a gritty victory over 1100m at Dubbo in C2 grade. Kept up to the mark with a tick over trial placing over 800m. Well drawn with the claim and looks up to this. IRISH JIG (8) shouldered the big weights at his last two outings and won't know himself with Neale's 3kg claim. Strong through the line when fourth over 1000m at Tamworth in C3 class. Tackling a deeper field this time but good enough to figure prominently. ANGIE'S SISTER (4) progressing well with the big weights, winning her last two starts by big margins in slick time. Another who will appreciate the 3kg claimer and not to be underestimated. BOMBAY BOOM (3) went forward with the 61kg and nailed late by STAR OF LILY over 1000m at Wagga. Sticky gate but gets the services of Nash Rawiller. The chances don't end there.
